description: Returns the DNS provider recorded for the domain, if known (e.g. Cloudflare, Namecheap): where its DNS records are configured. Custom domains only, and only while the domain is unverified; once its DNS is right there is nothing left to locate.

domain.description: Domain name (e.g. "www.example.com"). Must be a domain previously created with domains_set.

name: domains_dns

provider.description: The provider serving this domain's DNS; absent when unidentified.

name.description: Provider name, e.g. "Cloudflare"; null if unknown.

url.description: The provider's DNS dashboard, where the records get added; null or absent when unknown.

dns.description: What the platform recorded about the domain's DNS provider when the domain was created; null if nothing was recorded.

title: Get DNS Provider
